# Native record captures

The Claude and Codex usage captures and the observed model and effort captures were extracted on 2026-10-15 from existing local CLI session records; no model call was made to produce these fixtures. The two Grok Build 1.0.62 context captures were added later, shaped after a real session's records, and the values in `context_grok_1.0.62_signals.json` were set by hand to agree with the updates capture.

| Capture | Native source and version | Retained fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `usage_claude_2.1.296.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.296, version recorded on the original transcript entries | Five assistant content-block records with two message IDs and their complete native usage objects. IDs are replaced consistently. |
| `usage_codex_0.162.1.jsonl` | Codex 0.162.1, version in the rollout session metadata and installed `codex --version` | One `event_msg` / `token_count` with its complete `info` object. |
| `context_grok_1.0.62_updates.jsonl` | Grok Build 1.0.62, installed binary; shapes taken from a real session's `updates.jsonl` | Eight lines in order: streamed updates with `_meta.totalTokens` (3,187, 3,187, 81,406, 205,620), `auto_compact_started`, `auto_compact_completed` (`tokens_before` 205,620, `tokens_after` 25,032), a trailing update that still repeats 205,620, then one with 25,500. Message text is replaced by an ellipsis; session id and event ids are replaced. |
| `context_grok_1.0.62_signals.json` | Grok Build 1.0.62, installed binary and a real session's `signals.json` | Only the counters about compaction and the context (`compactionCount`, `totalTokensBeforeCompaction`, `contextWindowUsage`, `contextTokensUsed`, `contextWindowTokens`) and `turnCount`, with values set to agree with the updates capture. |
| `observed_claude.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.296 and 2.1.302, version on the original entries; installed `claude` is 2.1.302 | Four assistant records cut from real transcripts, in order: a main-transcript turn (2.1.296, `claude-opus-5`, effort `high`), a later main-transcript turn (2.1.302, `claude-opus-5-5`, `medium`), a sidechain turn from a `subagents/agent-*.jsonl` (2.1.302, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `high`) and a main-transcript `<synthetic>` notice (2.1.302, no effort). Only `type`, `isSidechain`, `message.id` (replaced), `message.model`, the complete native `message.usage`, the top-level `effort` and `version` are kept. |
| `observed_codex_0.162.1.jsonl` | Codex 0.162.1, `cli_version` in the rollout session metadata and installed `codex --version` | Two `turn_context` records from two rollouts (`gpt-6.1-sol` with effort `medium`, then `codex-auto-review` with `low`); only `type`, `payload.model` and `payload.effort` are kept. |
| `observed_codex_unset_effort_0.162.1.jsonl` | Codex 0.162.1, `cli_version` in the rollout session metadata and installed `codex --version`; captured 2026-10-20 | One `turn_context` record of a session whose configuration set no reasoning effort: Codex leaves the `effort` key out. Only `type` and `payload.model` remain. |
| `codex_models_cache_0.162.1.json` | Codex 0.162.1, the catalogue cache's own `client_version`; read from an account's `models_cache.json` on 2026-10-20 | `fetched_at`, `client_version` and three of the account's `models` entries (two listed, one hidden), each cut to `slug`, `display_name`, `default_reasoning_level`, the `effort` of each `supported_reasoning_levels` element and `visibility`. `identity`, `etag` and every other entry field are dropped. |
| `feed_claude_2.1.328.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.328 (most lines; single lines of 2.1.323, 2.1.327 and 2.1.295 where 2.1.328 held none of that shape: the slash command, its local-command line, the auto-continuation prompt, a prompt with no `origin` and the `ListAgents` call); captured 2026-11-20 from local transcripts, read for structure only, no model call made | 81 real lines, one chosen from a survey of all 170 local main transcripts and the subagent transcripts beside them (211,675 records, versions 2.1.286 to 2.1.328) for each distinct value the feed reader tells lines apart by: user `origin.kind` (`human`, `peer`, `task-notification`, `auto-continuation`, absent), `queued_command` attachments (human and not), a slash command line and its `isMeta` expansion, `isCompactSummary`, `compact_boundary`, `<synthetic>`, `isSidechain` lines, every `toolDenialKind` seen (`user-rejected`, `permission-rule`, `automode-blocked`, `automode-unavailable`, `interrupted`) beside an ordinary error result, string, text-list, `tool_reference` and image results, the interrupt note, and the tool names `Bash`, `Read`, `Edit`, `Write`, `Agent`, `SendMessage`, `ToolSearch`, `Skill`, `TaskStop`, `Monitor`, `ListAgents`, `WebSearch`, `WebFetch` and an `mcp__` tool, plus the system, attachment and bookkeeping lines (`turn_duration`, `stop_hook_summary`, `away_summary`, `informational`, `output_style`, `queue-operation`, `last-prompt` and the like) that yield nothing. Every line keeps its keys, structure and non-content values (types, flags, origin, denial kind, models, versions); the `uuid` and `parentUuid` links, tool-call ids and timestamps are set afresh so the lines form one conversation (a typed prompt with three calls made together whose results hang off side branches, a queued message, a compaction, an interrupted prompt sent again as a sibling and a rewind to before the compaction); all message text, tool inputs and outputs, paths, ids, session identities and the working directory are replaced with invented values. No `TodoWrite` call exists in any local transcript, so the reader's `TodoWrite` case is a unit test input, not part of this capture, and was not observed. |
| `feed_codex_0.167.1_rollout.jsonl` | Codex 0.167.1, sanitized from real rollouts under `~/.codex/sessions` on 2026-11-20 (824 rollouts, 327,043 records, `cli_version` 0.163.0 x131, 0.166.0 x613, 0.167.0 x46, 0.167.1 x321; the pieces come from 0.166.0, 0.167.0 and 0.167.1 rollouts; no model call) | 45 records, each the first real example of its kind that was short enough: `task_started`, a `UserMessage`, a `Reasoning` item, a commentary `AgentMessage`, `sleep` (call, its `clock.sleep` item, output), `exec` (call and list output), a completed and a failed `CommandExecution`, a `FileChange`, a completed and a failed `McpToolCall`, an `ImageView`, `wait_agent` (call, `CollabAgentToolCall`, output), `spawn_agent` (call, `SubAgentActivity`, output), `wait` on an exec cell, `request_user_input_async` (call, an `AgentMessage` item with the call's id and the questions, output), a `web.search` `Extension`, `list_agents`, `interrupt_agent` (with its `SubAgentActivity`), a `compaction` response item, `spawn_agent` calls with no output at lines 34, 36, 39 and 41 (one record, repeated under four ids, ending four ways: followed by `turn_aborted`, by `task_started`, by a `task_complete` without error, by a `task_complete` with an `error`), a second `UserMessage` (the first one's record again at line 38, with its text set to "Continue"; line 37 is the `task_started` record of line 1 again), a `compacted` line with its `ContextCompaction` item and a final-answer `AgentMessage`. Every key, nesting and non-content value (types, kinds, statuses, phases, tools, timestamps, numbers) is as recorded; message and command text, outputs, paths, cwd, urls, queries, MCP server names, ids and the encrypted blobs are invented, with ids renamed consistently so each call, its item and its output still match; each real record that is repeated (`spawn_agent`, `task_started`, `UserMessage`) is given its own ids, and `compacted` keeps one history entry of its 25. The user, commentary and final texts, the two commands and their outputs were then set by hand. The records are in an order chosen for the test, not one session's. Compared against the survey of the same rollouts: every call name seen (`exec`, `send_message`, `sleep`, `spawn_agent`, `followup_task`, `wait_agent`, `wait`, `request_user_input_async`, `list_agents`, `interrupt_agent`) and every item type; no real `js`, `shell`, `exec_command`, `update_plan` or declined `FileChange` record exists locally. |
| `feed_grok_1.0.89_chat_history.jsonl` | Grok Build, sanitized lines of five local sessions (the installed binary is 1.0.89; a session does not record its version, so the sessions, created 2026-09-29 to 2026-11-18, cannot be tied to one build) | 62 lines in five stretches, each a run of lines of one session in recorded order: a compacted session (`system`, the `<user_info>` and summary `compaction_meta` lines, the kept `<user_query>`, `system_reminder` lines, `reasoning`, `assistant` lines with `run_terminal_command`, `read_file`, `search_replace`, `search_tool` and `use_tool` calls, their `tool_result` lines), a session with a cancelled command, one with two failing `search_replace` calls, two `todo_write` calls with `merge` true (with a `get_command_or_subagent_output` and a `run_terminal_command` call) and a `backend_tool_call` web search. Every key, line type and structure is as recorded. Text, tool inputs and results, paths and ids are invented, consistently across both files; the search's id was replaced with the one of the web search in the updates capture, which came from another session. The 180 local sessions were surveyed for their line types, for which tools they called and for where `compaction_meta` lines sit (at a session's start after a compaction, the file having been rewritten); these stretches were picked as the smallest that show each shape. |
| `feed_grok_1.0.89_updates.jsonl` | Grok Build, the same sessions' `updates.jsonl`, sanitized in the same way | 211 lines: `user_message_chunk`, `agent_message_chunk` and `agent_thought_chunk`, `tool_call` and `tool_call_update` (running, `completed`, `failed`), `hook_execution`, `hook_annotation`, `turn_completed` (`cancelled`, `end_turn`) and the three compaction lines (`auto_compact_started`, `compaction_checkpoint`, `auto_compact_completed`), whose position shows the log still holding the model calls before the compaction, among them nineteen web searches the rewritten record no longer has. The first stretch is cut off mid-turn with no `turn_completed`; the stretches' `timestamp` values are shifted to one invented base and their gaps kept. The web search (lines 209 and 210, the stitched pair) is two `ws_…` lines (`tool_call` `in_progress` with `_meta.backend`, then `completed`) from a session whose record holds no `backend_tool_call` line. The two `todo_write` calls have no `agent_message_chunk`. |

The Grok model and effort replay through the existing `titles_grok_1.0.60_summary.json` capture (`current_model_id`, `reasoning_effort`).

Transcript content, file paths, session/request identities, timestamps and unrelated record metadata were omitted from the JSONL captures. Token values and nested usage structures of the Claude and Codex captures are unchanged. When `usage_claude_2.1.296.jsonl` was captured, the latest available Claude transcript was produced by 2.1.296; the installed executable had since advanced to 2.1.300, which was not run against a model to create a new capture.

The context size is read from these as follows. Claude repeats the same final per-message usage in multiple content-block records; the size is the last line's input (`input_tokens` plus cache creation plus cache read, output left out), so the capture gives 48,762 for the first message and 52,051 for the second. Codex's `token_count` gives the last request's `last_token_usage.total_tokens` and the `model_context_window` (18,829 of 475,000). The existing `rollout_running_turn.jsonl` capture is replayed as a native near-miss: `token_count` with `info: null` reports no known context. The Grok captures replay to 25,500 tokens in a 256,000 window: the compaction gives 25,032, and the update repeating 205,620 after it is skipped.
